_note: The first campaign (PLAN.md 15.8). Thin content on a real mechanism, deliberately:
three scenarios, each on a GENERATED River map against a PASSIVE opponent, teaching
the economy, then the age ladder, then fighting.
`scenarios` NAMES ITS FOLDERS IN PLAY ORDER AND THAT ORDER IS NOT DERIVABLE.
`scenario_10` sorts before `scenario_2`, so sorting the directory names would put a
tenth scenario second -- and a campaign's order is a design decision anyway. A folder
holding a scenario.json that this list does not name is REPORTED rather than played
last, because it is either work in progress or a typo in this list.
PROGRESS IS NOT IN THIS FILE and cannot be: an update is allowed to replace this
folder wholesale, and it must not take the player's place in the campaign with it.
Progress is user://campaign_progress.json, keyed by this folder's NAME -- so renaming
the directory forgets how far every player had got.
name: How To Play
description: Three short lessons: gather and build, climb the ages, then find your opponent and finish them.
